title: Mixed Event — Never Give Up Cooking! — Episode6 Time To Taste!

meta.Event Outline: Tsukasa and Saki invite Toya over for a party. With White Day approaching, he wants to give something back to the two of them. He tries his hand at baking from scratch, with varying results...

rows.Line: Aoyagi Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Are they out, Toya? How do they look?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Y-Yes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They're bright blue... I'm not sure they should be this color... Also, some of them appear to have burst somehow...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did we really succeed...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yes, they're a strange color...
But I don't think that's a bad thing.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I remember hearing a story about how certain cakes abroad can look like this.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I agree that they may've sort of fallen apart, but it also means they rose much better compared to last time, no?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, they should be fluffier and more delicious.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A-Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Still, I got a completely different result compared to last time when I made them on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As unfortunate as it is that sort of fell apart, but Miku may be right about them tasting better...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay... Then, I'll have Kamishiro try these. He also seemed to be looking forward to tasting them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Sure. I'm going to head back now, so good luck, Toya.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku.
I'll stop by SEKAI later to tell you how things went.
Aoyagi Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I heard the timer for the oven go off just now. They must be done.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe... I think they're finally ready.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
These are the cupcakes I just baked.
Would you mind trying them now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. That's why I'm here, aren't I? Now, let's see what you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (What in the world...?!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry. I know they're not all that appealing visually... But I'm sure they taste fine...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I suppose so...
After all, it's not good to judge a book by its cover...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: S-So, I'll just have to see how they taste...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Still... This is, well...
Quite a sight to behold, to say the least...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The color alone is making my eyes spin... They're bright blue and purple... And the rainbow sprinkles are making me want to eat them even less...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that, the tops of these cupcakes look like they've somehow spilled over. They must've risen far too much while in the oven...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's like a dam burst and released a torrent of poisonous-looking batter...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (My mind doesn't seem to recognize these as food... So much so that my appetite from before has completely gone.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I can't tell how they taste with my eyes. I'll just have to hope that they taste okay...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This sandy texture... It's spreading throughout my mouth... What is this? Sugar? Did it not melt properly or something...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But it isn't just sweet...
It's like I'm drinking medicine here and there... It's so bitter...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And some spots on the surface are rock hard, while others are too soft... This is hardly what I'd call a good texture...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I think I can stomach it, but I'd strongly refrain from giving these to someone as a gift...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So...how are they...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe... Well...
In short, they're very unique...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unique...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I'll try one as well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Guh...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This is...terrible...
I'm so sorry. Please, let me toss those for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, I'll finish them...
You did your best to make these, no?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Understood...
In return, let me get you something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, thank you. That would be much appreciated.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
All gone. And thank you for the coffee. That was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, that was just instant coffee mixed with hot water...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
More importantly, I'm so sorry...
I didn't realize how awful they'd taste...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, they had an interesting taste...
But there's no need to feel so down since you're just learning how to bake.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I guess this is simply too much for me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I failed when I tried by myself, and I failed when I had someone teach me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even if I were to get a little better by practicing, I probably wouldn't be able to make anything good in time for the dinner party...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which means I won't be able to put a smile on Tsukasa and Saki's faces...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, at your current rate, you likely won't have a gift ready in time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it's clear that you did everything you could to make the best cupcakes possible.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Above all else, Tsukasa and Saki...
Between your most recent efforts and what you've said, I can tell that you wish to see them smile very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, if you give up now and choose to give them something else, I believe you'll regret not seeing this through until the end.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that may be so... But...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He's feeling worse about this than I initially thought... I suppose there isn't much I can do about that since this is his second time failing...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The truth is, I never really saw Toya smile all that much back then. He always seemed preoccupied...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's changed quite a bit since then, but as an older brother figure, I'd like to see him smile more.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He wants him to smile more... I may not feel as strongly about that as Tsukasa, but I too would like to see him smile...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you seem to hold Tsukasa in very high regard. You've also known him and Saki since you were all little, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me more about the time you all spent together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't mind...
But why all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought it would help take your mind off things for a bit. Talking for a moment may help cheer you up, no?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I may've mentioned this before, but I first met the Tenmas because our respective parents are friends with each other.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd go over to Tsukasa's house whenever my parents were gone, and he'd babysit me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My dad is a renowned classical musician, and he made me study classical music from a very young age...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because of that, I had few opportunities to play with friends or go over to their house...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As a result, when I was first asked to stay over at someone else's house, I was very scared...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, as I played with Tsukasa, that fear slowly evaporated... In time, I'd begin to look forward to going over to his house.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... So being able to spend time with Tsukasa meant quite a lot to the little version of you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, Saki didn't appear in your story. Can you tell me more about how you spent time with her...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I actually didn't get many chances to see Saki...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Really?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Saki got sick very often when she was little, so she wasn't always there whenever I went over to visit...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, but... When she was home, the three of us would play together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We'd read picture books and watch the shows Tsukasa came up with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa came up with his own shows...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that day... I remember how I was heavily scolded by my dad during practice...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Toya seems kinda sad today...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I'm going to turn Toya's frown upside down by doing a show for him! You too, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, bring me your horsy plushie!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Okay! Hey, Toya, come here!
Let's watch Tsukasa's show together!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
His shows are really fun!
You'll be smiling from ear to ear after watching it!

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Before I knew it, I became so entranced by Tsukasa's performance that I couldn't help but smile.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Saki was also smiling a lot.
We even discussed how good it was afterwards...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To me, those two... And that house...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They have this uncanny ability to fill my heart with so much warmth...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on your gentle expression, I can tell that they mean quite a lot to you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, they do...
But did I make that sort of face just now...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I guess that's never going to change...
The time we all spent together... It'll always be a source of encouragement for me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That's all the more reason to want them to enjoy my gift...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which means I don't have time to be feeling sad...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Kamishiro. I feel much better now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm going to give this another try tomorrow. I vow to succeed and bake some delicious cupcakes that they're genuinely going to enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, I'd like to try them when they're done. I'll taste test for you as much as you need.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You will...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even after I made you eat...those...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Especially if it means seeing Tsukasa and Saki smile.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much...
